name: Gods Faithfulness
overview: Scripture reveals God's faithfulness as an unchanging and trustworthy attribute grounded in His very nature, distinct from human frailty and falsehood, as Numbers 23:19 affirms. The Lord is faithful to keep His covenant and extend mercy to those who love Him and obey His commands, demonstrated in Deuteronomy 7:9 and Lamentations 3:22. Believers find protection and assurance in His truth, which acts as a shield, and are called to steadfastly hold to their faith because God reliably fulfills His promises, as Hebrews 10:23 and Psalms 91:4 illustrate.
